description: Sri Lanka Customs -  Rates of Exchange w.e.f. 18.09.2017 to 24.09.2017
categorisation: This gazette notification is issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) and establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and charges. It constitutes a regulatory framework for customs operations, making it a Legal/Regulatory matter. The content involves the Director General of Customs exercising statutory powers to determine and modify financial regulations, which falls under Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes) rather than government personnel or organizational changes.
